system.statement: QuantRule turns historical OHLCV candles into reproducible evidence about whether a rule-based alpha has an edge. It does not trade, connect to a broker, or provide real-time risk.

rows.claim: Every run reads one immutable data version and only its declared partition; a later bar cannot enter an earlier output.
rows.test: partition checker; data-quality and causality tests
rows.boundary: The repository proves the partition and version contract and the causality tests; it does not audit the operator's external source files.
rows.notes: 2023 is excluded from every partition; portfolio_holdout is 2025 with five instruments.

rows.claim: Every improvement run is pre-registered before execution; validation is one-shot and a development run cannot read the holdout.
rows.test: research create/submit/decide tests and the run-contract validator
rows.boundary: The contract and validators are current; no tiered run has used v3 yet, so the first live pre-registration remains a research action, not evidence of an edge.
rows.notes: holdout_access is none except final for portfolio_holdout; a public create is immutable.

rows.claim: A significance claim carries a pre-registered correction and primary-cell count, and the qualification evidence records it.
rows.test: quantrule-research evaluation tests and qualification fixtures
rows.boundary: The correction is recorded in the evidence; it is not a promise that a future program will find an edge.
rows.notes: The multiple_testing declaration carries the family alpha, correction, primary cells and trials.

rows.claim: A worker or evidence-leader failure leaves no succeeded run without a digest and reproduces the same canonical digest after retry.
rows.boundary: Single physical host; it does not prove host power loss, AZ loss, or a true network partition.
rows.notes: Digest parity after worker and leader SIGKILL; the recorded RTO is 70 s and 36 s.

rows.claim: A point-in-time restore reproduces the same canonical digest or fails cleanly.
rows.boundary: In-place lab restore; it does not prove a production PITR, a second site, or a real-host RTO.
rows.notes: RPO 2 s, total 219 s, expected and observed digest match in the 2026-11-25 lab.

rows.claim: A referenced pack or signal is never collected; an unreferenced artifact is collected only after 30 days with a tombstone.
rows.test: artifact retention tests in the data and evidence services
rows.boundary: The 30-day window and tombstone are tested; a live MinIO retention sweep is not run here.
rows.notes: A registered reference protects an artifact; a new signal may stay unreferenced for 30 days.

rows.claim: The browser and CLI reach the gateway over HTTPS with the bearer token and no certificate bypass, and a lost client reconnects with a bounded retry.
rows.boundary: The lab exercises the remote client path from the lab host; it is not a separate physical machine or a public CA.
rows.notes: Only 443 is public; the token is required; the private CA is used without a certificate bypass.

rows.claim: A broker or worker loss does not lose an acknowledged run, the queue drains, and a failed worker leaves one digest.
rows.test: deploy/v3/test.sh --confirm; queue loss, worker kill, queue-depth metrics and verify
rows.boundary: The lab proves one-broker loss and a worker kill; it does not prove a 48-hour soak or production capacity.
rows.notes: A new quorum leader was elected in 7 s; queue depth and worker counts are metrics; the 48-hour soak is the separate V20 gate.

accepted_risks.risk: RR-04, RR-05, RR-07 and RR-08 are proven on the three-VM single-host lab, not on separate physical hosts or a separate remote client machine.
accepted_risks.impact: Host power loss, AZ loss, a true network partition, and a real public-CA remote client remain unproven.
accepted_risks.residual_risk: The research readiness claim is Simulated HA; Real HA remains HA-22/HA-23 and a separate remote client run.
accepted_risks.next_action: HA-22/HA-23 real-host gate and QA-009 remote client parity; the release note states the boundary.
